name: useDevice
summary: Device identity, battery level, thermistor temperature, voltage, current, and wattage.
plain: Facts about the phone, its hardware identity, and its real physical power state: battery level, fuel gauge thermistor temperature, instantaneous cell voltage and current flow, wattage draw/charging rate, health status, and lifetime charge cycles.
description: Identity comes from expo-device, external-power state from native battery EXTRA_PLUGGED and expo-battery listeners, and deep physical battery telemetry from PixelNative.getBatteryTelemetry(). isCharging reports whether AC, USB, wireless, or dock power is attached, including Android NOT_CHARGING while a full battery or charge limit pauses current flow; null means unreadable. Inspect batteryTelemetry.status to distinguish CHARGING, FULL, and NOT_CHARGING. batteryTemperatureC reads the actual lithium pack NTC thermistor in 0.1 °C units. batteryVoltageMv and batteryCurrentMa give cell voltage and live current; batteryPowerWatts computes wattage (V × |I|). On Android 14+, batteryCycleCount reads lifetime charge cycles. Unavailable readings are null.
signature: useDevice(): DeviceTelemetry & { batteryPercent, batteryTemperatureC, batteryVoltageMv, batteryCurrentMa, batteryCurrentAvgMa, batteryPowerWatts, batteryHealth, batteryCycleCount, batteryChargeCounterMah, batteryEnergyCounterMwh, batteryTechnology, pluggedSource, batteryTelemetry, hasRead, error, source, refresh }

returns.name: modelName
returns.desc: Commercial model name (e.g. "Pixel 11 Pro"); null when the platform does not report it.

returns.name: brand
returns.desc: Hardware manufacturer brand (e.g. "Google"); null when the platform does not report it.

returns.name: osVersion
returns.desc: Android release string; null when the platform does not report it.

returns.name: batteryPercent
returns.desc: Charge remaining as an integer percentage, 0 to 100. Null until the first read; it is never reported as 0 to fill the gap.

returns.name: batteryPercent
returns.desc: Honest charge percentage, null until the platform answers.

returns.name: isCharging
returns.desc: External charger attached (AC, USB, wireless or dock), even when Android pauses charging at 100% or a charge limit. Null until observed; batteryTelemetry.status distinguishes active charging from paused/full.

returns.name: lowPowerMode
returns.desc: Whether Battery Saver is active; null until the first read or when the read failed. Treat true as a direct instruction to do less work.

returns.name: networkType
returns.desc: Active network connection type (e.g. "WIFI", "CELLULAR").

returns.name: isConnected
returns.desc: Whether a working, reachable internet route exists.

returns.name: totalMemoryMB
returns.desc: Total system LPDDR5X RAM in MB, when the platform reports it.

returns.name: batteryTemperatureC
returns.desc: Real physical battery temperature in °C from the fuel gauge NTC thermistor.

returns.name: batteryVoltageMv
returns.desc: Instantaneous battery cell terminal voltage in millivolts (e.g. 4120 mV).

returns.name: batteryCurrentMa
returns.desc: Instantaneous current flow in mA (negative discharging, positive charging).

returns.name: batteryCurrentAvgMa
returns.desc: Rolling average current flow in mA from the fuel gauge.

returns.name: batteryPowerWatts
returns.desc: Real-time power consumption or fast-charging rate in Watts (V × |I|).

returns.name: batteryHealth
returns.desc: Hardware battery health state reported by the PMIC.

returns.name: batteryCycleCount
returns.desc: Lifetime charge cycle count stored in the battery EEPROM (Android 14+).

returns.name: batteryChargeCounterMah
returns.desc: Remaining battery charge capacity in milliampere-hours (mAh).

returns.name: batteryEnergyCounterMwh
returns.desc: Remaining stored energy in milliwatt-hours (mWh).

returns.name: batteryTechnology
returns.desc: Battery cell chemistry string (e.g. "Li-ion").

returns.name: pluggedSource
returns.desc: Observed AC, USB, wireless, dock or NONE power source; null if the battery broadcast was unreadable.

returns.name: batteryTelemetry
returns.desc: Full native battery telemetry structure including probed thermal zones.

returns.name: hasRead
returns.desc: Whether any power, battery, or network value has been successfully read.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if the last telemetry read failed, null otherwise.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

actions.name: refresh
actions.desc: Re-reads device power, PMIC battery fuel gauge, and network connectivity.
actions.output: Promise<void> — Resolves once all battery, electrical, and network states are refreshed.

agentNote: Respect lowPowerMode: reduce sensor intervals and defer heavy work when true. Use batteryTemperatureC and batteryVoltageMv for real battery hardware metrics rather than simulating values.
